projects.purpose: Conversational AI system for discovering and understanding clinical trials through natural-language search, patient profile matching, semantic ranking, and trial explanations.
projects.contribution: Contributed conversational and LLM functionality, conversation state, patient-matching features, additional data and functionality, a Streamlit frontend, and deployment-related configuration. Also reorganized the project structure and added LangChain functionality.

projects.purpose: A daily-use wardrobe assistant delivered as a command-line application for managing wardrobe items, generating outfit recommendations, recording wears and ratings, and incorporating learned preferences.
projects.contribution: Contributed the TypeScript implementation of the domain model, YAML storage layer, availability and constraint logic, hybrid deterministic/LLM recommendation flow, CLI commands for wardrobe and outfit management, friendly LLM error handling, and a deterministic evaluation harness. The daily loop was verified end to end from adding items through rating an outfit.

projects.purpose: A Python pipeline that collects AI engineering posts from X, normalizes and deduplicates them, uses AI agents to curate and verify stories, and publishes a searchable static HTML feed.
projects.contribution: Built the project’s collection, processing, curation, verification, publishing, state-management, and GitHub Actions workflow components. Added tests for normalization, publishing, and related file operations, along with safeguards for malformed model output, failed pipeline runs, duplicate stories, and concurrent state updates.

projects.purpose: Backend for a voice agent that supports calendar booking, availability lookup, and post-call summaries.
projects.contribution: Implemented Vercel API routes for Google Calendar event creation and availability searches, including input validation and Pacific Time handling. Added a signed post-call webhook with HMAC-SHA256 verification and Resend email summaries, plus error handling and Vitest coverage for key validation and failure cases.

projects.purpose: An AI Trailblazers planning system that turns hackathon inputs such as city, timing, budget, audience, and purpose into a sourced HTML event plan. It includes streamed pipeline activity, saved run permalinks, and a public gallery of plans.
projects.contribution: Implemented and iterated on the agentic planning pipeline, validated intake flow, streamed activity log, sandboxed plan rendering, Neon-backed run persistence, permalink viewer, public gallery, and shared navigation. Also added AITB-scoped skills, configurations, and workflows, including Airtable organization lookup.

projects.purpose: A packaged, popup-only Chrome Manifest V3 extension providing callback-free six-digit email OTP sign-in, authenticated member state, display-name editing, and Grovekin presentation features.
projects.contribution: Implemented the React/TypeScript popup and event-driven service worker architecture, including worker-owned Supabase sessions and storage, OTP resend cooldowns, credential refresh, popup messaging, idempotent display-name updates, sign-out cleanup, transactional notices, and automated verification through packaged builds and real-Chrome smoke testing.

projects.purpose: SafeTrip SF is an AI-powered travel-planning application for San Francisco that generates personalized itineraries while incorporating traveler-safety analysis based on real crime data. It accepts natural-language preferences such as budget, interests, and trip duration; produces hotel and activity recommendations; assigns safety scores; and visualizes routes and higher-risk areas on an interactive map.
projects.contribution: The repository documents a multi-agent pipeline comprising intake, itinerary planning, safety analysis, and map-building components, connected through a FastAPI backend and Streamlit frontend. The project includes analysis of 10,129 crime incidents across 41 neighborhoods, a combined planning endpoint, individual agent endpoints, and datasets containing 24 activities and 12 hotels.

projects.purpose: A Skill Observer MVP for repository-scoped Codex invocation discovery, invocation capture normalization, investigation, and deterministic signal evaluation, with a local web display and CLI workflow.
projects.contribution: Implemented the Skill Observer MVP, including discovery and investigation flows, Codex adapters, signal evaluation, local operation handling, a CLI picker, web display, fixture-based investigation, and supporting tests and completion evidence.

projects.purpose: A GitHub Pages Minimal-theme portfolio with a TypeScript Portfolio Maintainer that synchronizes public GitHub pins and refreshes a Recent Work digest.
projects.contribution: Contributed to building the portfolio site and maintainer, implementing digest lifecycle workflows, and configuring GitHub Pages automation with validation and checkpoint-preserving behavior.
